scientific_integrity: All-dimensional claims are proved analytically. Finite Gaussian-integral evaluation, face enumeration and seeded simulations are independent corroboration, not infinite certification. Full historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Invariant affine-hyperplane measure conditioned on intersection, not a direction-uniform sampling alternative. Fixed face ranks in the limit. Independent audit and exhaustive historical priority verification have not been performed.
title: Exact face-vector law and uniform-square exponent for affine sections of regular simplices
